notes.title: Update 12: It's Rainig Men
notes.notes:
Hey gamers, get ready for a juicy update you won't want to miss!

This release is dedicated to the recent "sky-high adventure" of Yevgeny Prigozhin, a military criminal and former leader of the Wagner PMC, also known as "Putin's Chef."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42494388/136c671c919f5a54473ed82b1108348b1670be3c.png[/img]

[h2]Plot[/h2]
[b]Putler has a brilliant idea: Prigozhin could learn a brand-new recipe for the Russian soup okroshka in some other dimension[/b].
So, he sends him on a culinary journey by dematerializing his plane at the right place and time.
Shoigu and Gerasimov succeed in executing, let's just say, the explosive part of this elegant ritual.
Yet, as Prigozhin embarks on his astral traversal, unforeseen complexities unveil themselves...

[h2]About Development[/h2]
Well, folks. We were actually working on entirely different game features, but the madness of the Putinists perpetually derails all plans. SCRUM, Agile, Waterfall — nothing helps here!

We had to urgently do an unplanned reskin of Prigozhin, rendering him a translucent wraith bathed in an azure luminescence.
As a result, we got a bit carried away and ended up creating an in-game event featuring a unique environment, new mechanics, and even a mini-boss.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Player teleportation effects implemented
[*] ⚽ New mechanic: Hats can now be kicked off by enemies
[*] 🎯 "Traktor Attack" power-up now appears only when there are 3 or more enemies on the battlefield
[*] 🛡️ Rotating shields nerfed (130 → 60 hitpoints)
[*] 🤝 Allies rebalanced (150 → 120 hitpoints)
[*] 🔀 Fixed bug where only one ally could teleport to the next levels
[*] 🛡️ Rotating shields and energy shield can now be teleported to the next levels
[*] 🔊 Zombie and Ghost Jirinovsky now have distinct attack sounds
[*] 👻 Ghost Jirinovsky: Added appearance and death sounds
[*] 🧟 Zombie Jirinovsky: Added monster transformation scream
[*] ⏳ Time Control Power-Up appears if at least one enemy is on the battlefield
[*] 🎯 Fixed errors when enemies launch targeted projectiles after the player is already killed
[*] 🎩 Fixed visual bug related to incorrect positioning of light source in wizard hat's glowing orb explosion
[*] 🌐 Fixed bug where the player knocked out of game area by an enemy may disappear
[/list]

So, who do you think will be the next Putinist to get a "refreshing" reskin?

notes.title: Update 11
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42494388/0babf56d6bcc2de631663d4e3cb9a49ba5b05fba.png[/img]

[h2]Unleash Unique Powers with Enhanced Characters[/h2]
No two heroes fight alike! Each playable character now comes with their own set of unique traits and abilities. Unleash your inner warrior with unprecedented tactical depth.

[h2]UI Revamps for a Seamless Experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] "New game" screen reworked
[*] Pause screen reworked: updated UI, joystick support, quick settings (possibility to change sound and  music volume)
[*]  Credits page returned and reworked
[/list]

[h2]Turn Up the Volume: New Tunes Have Arrived[/h2]
Get ready to rock your battles with brand-new soundtracks from the audaciously talented band "Deth Rate a Politics." Immerse yourself in each mission as these electrifying tunes elevate your gaming experience to a whole new level of awesomeness.
Don't just play — feel the music, feel the action!

[h2]Smoothing the Edges: Bugfixes & Minor Improvements[/h2]

Attention to detail can make or break an immersive gaming experience, and we're all about the details. This update focuses on smoothing out the rough edges—whether it's optimizing localization for better accessibility or resolving gameplay glitches. Below you'll find a curated list of tweaks and fixes aimed at providing a more seamless journey.

[list]
[*] Added missing title and voice localizations for power-ups
[*] Bugfix: Removed pitch randomization from power-up voicing
[*] Bugfix: Fixed shooting via joystick while paused
[*] Bugfix: "Claim reward" button restored to besiary pages
[*] Bugfix: Locked joystick controls at start of tutorial
[*] Bugfix: Added missing button press sounds on bestiary page when using controller
[*] Localization fixes in Ukrainian, German, and Polish
[*] Possibility to skip intro and tutorial dialogues using a joystick
[*] Updated to more informative character names
[/list]

Dive back into the game now and experience all these incredible updates firsthand.
Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Update 8
notes.notes:
The following changes were released during the last week, in addition to the new features of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985240/view/3416569163136752329]"Ghost of Makhno"[/url] Halloween in-game event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42494388/56522e79623b792b78148ce10306dc65beb467e8.png[/img]
[h1]Main features[/h1]

There are four new playable characters from Ukraine, the United States, Canada, and Germany.

Most commentators get animations.

Regarding the Crimean Bridge explosion and the attack on the Russian fleet in the Black Sea, we added a new commentator ("I don't want to leave Crimea, Alushta at all, how cool it is here!")


Regarding the new commander of all Russian forces invading Ukraine, we added him to a game as an enemy.

One more enemy: a person who is behind the occupation of Crimea in the Russian Federation.

[h2]Visuals[/h2]

Derbis, smoke, and lens flare were added to large explosions to improve them.

Duda's default laser color was changed to red-white (the flag of Poland).

Blood splash animations of worms now go faster to prevent the screen from being littered with too many blood splashes.

[h2]Localisation[/h2]

Misspelling fixed in the Ukrainian translation

Hitpoints increase powerup: translation added

[h2]Sound[/h2]

Hitpoints increase powerup: Voicing added

Reduce the priority of the worm blood splash sound to avoid music stopping; reduce the volume of the worm blood splash sound.

Pitch randomisation added to blood splash and explosion sounds

[h2]Game Balance[/h2]

Jirinovsky's zombie and its ghost have been rebalanced; they now leave the game screen faster if not destroyed.

[h2]Other bugfixes [/h2]

Fixes in game logic that relies on player character personality

notes.title: Mystery of Nestor's Ghost
notes.notes:
Hello, slayers of putinists!
We celebrate Halloween with a special in-game event.

[h2]The Mystery of Nestor's Ghost[/h2]
During the next two weeks, you can meet new Halloween-themed enemies.
Eliminate them to earn special points.
Then use special points to unlock a new character: the Ghost of Nestor Makhno.

[h2]Points conversion[/h2]
Special points earned in previous in-game events will be converted to Halloween special points.

[h2]Halloween Powerups[/h2]
We introduce new powerups dedicated to the Halloween holiday.

[h3]Vampirism[/h3]
Each time you eliminate the enemy, you restore a small amount of health.

[h3]Witch's hat[/h3]
This hat not only looks awesome, but it also adds 3 energy orbs that rotate around the player and hit enemies.

Themed powerups will remain available after in-game event but will have reduced chances of appearing.

Wishing you a great Halloween and a fantastic fall.
Glory to Ukraine!
